correctness.rationale: For all n>=2, u>=0 and h_i>=0, any misassigned private-zero chore admits a Pareto improvement by moving it to its unique zero-cost owner; all correctly placed private chores attain minimum aggregate cost u even fractionally. Strong chore EFX quantifies over EVERY owned item, including private-zero ones; the exact residual comparison is c_i-1_{h_i=0}<=c_j+h_j for each i!=j. Multinomial occupancy count follows. For two agents the allowable common chore counts are adjacent central occupancies, giving the proved odd-u halving/even-u increase. For symmetric h>=1, the condition reduces to max c-min c<=h, and multinomial CLT of centered counts plus continuity of the Gaussian range and fixed-width Stirling yield the stated scaling and asymptotics. Empty bundles, u=0, and h_i=0 are handled; no arbitrary binary cost matrix is claimed.
